items.name: American Express
items.headline: Raises 2026 EPS guidance after Q3 results
items.catalyst: Q3 revenues net of interest expense were $20,062M versus $18,426M; diluted EPS was $5.42 versus $4.14 (adjusted $4.68) and 2026 EPS guidance is $18.30 to $18.60 ($17.60 to $17.90 adjusted).
items.thesis: Billed business was $454.0B versus $421.0B, and the provision for credit losses was $1.0B versus $1.3B, which the release attributes to a reserve release this quarter against a reserve build last year. Reported EPS includes a GBTG gain, so adjusted EPS is the cleaner comparison.
items.source_name: American Express Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.name: Danaher
items.headline: Raises 2026 adjusted EPS guidance after Q3 results
items.catalyst: Q3 sales were $6,554M versus $6,053M with core sales growth of 3.0%; adjusted diluted EPS was $2.11 versus $1.89, and full-year adjusted EPS guidance is now $8.57 to $8.62 versus $8.45 to $8.60 before.
items.thesis: Excluding respiratory testing, core growth was 5.5%, according to the release. Free cash flow was $1,632M versus $1,370M, so cash generation grew faster than core sales.
items.source_name: Danaher Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.name: American Airlines Group
items.headline: Q3 loss widens as fuel expense climbs $1.9B; Q4 outlook issued
items.catalyst: Q3 total operating revenues were $16,335M versus $13,691M, up 19.3%, but fuel expense was $4,635M versus $2,767M and the GAAP net loss was $269M versus $114M.
items.thesis: The company guides a Q4 adjusted loss per share of $(1.10) to $(0.50) and a full-year loss of $(1.60) to $(1.00), assuming fuel of about $4.70 per gallon in Q4. Fuel is the variable the outlook leans on.
items.source_name: American Airlines Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.name: Dow Inc.
items.headline: Operating EPS turns positive in Q3 as sales rise in all segments
items.catalyst: Q3 net sales were $11,267M versus $9,973M; GAAP diluted EPS was $0.62 versus $0.08, and operating EPS was $0.71 versus a loss of $0.19.
items.thesis: Cash from operations in continuing operations was $1,839M versus $1,130M. The release gives no Q4 guidance but says self-help actions are on track to deliver more than $1B of EBITDA uplift in both 2026 and 2027.
items.source_name: Dow Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, Ex. 99.1)

items.name: SLB
items.headline: Q3 revenue grows while per-share earnings dip slightly
items.catalyst: Q3 revenue was $9,449M versus $8,928M; GAAP diluted EPS was $0.49 versus $0.50 and EPS excluding charges and credits was $0.64 versus $0.69.
items.thesis: North America revenue was $2,401M, up 24%, but that includes ChampionX and was up 13% excluding the acquisition. SLB repurchased 12.9M shares for $656M and still expects about $2.5B of 2026 capital investment.
items.source_name: SLB Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, Ex. 99)

items.name: Gentex
items.headline: Narrows 2026 revenue and gross margin outlook after Q3
items.catalyst: Q3 net sales were $647.7M versus $655.2M and GAAP diluted EPS was $0.43 versus $0.46; 2026 revenue is now expected at approximately $2.65B versus $2.65B to $2.75B before.
items.thesis: Gross margin guidance moved to 34.0% to 34.5% from 34.5% to 35.5%, and the company attributed lower Q3 margin to higher precious metal costs and lower-than-expected sales. The 2027 revenue outlook of $2.80B to $2.90B was maintained.

items.name: Zymeworks
items.headline: Licenses ZW209 to Roche with $55M upfront
items.catalyst: Zymeworks and Roche agreed a license for ZW209, a DLL3-targeting T cell engager, with $55M upfront, $40M on Phase 1b initiation and up to $718M in further milestones.
items.thesis: Royalties are tiered from high-single-digit to mid-teen percentages, and Roche funds the Phase 1a trial. The agreement remains conditioned on the HSR Act waiting period expiring or terminating.
